title: Rescission.
bodyText: Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this chapter, any action for rescission brought under this chapter shall commence prior to the recorded sale of the real property.
bodyHtml: [§508D-16.5]  Rescission.  Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this chapter, any action for rescission brought under this chapter shall commence prior to the recorded sale of the real property. [L 1995, c 108, §1]
